为什么青蛙能告诉我们河水是否健康？

Why can frogs tell us if a river is healthy?

青蛙的皮肤很薄，水里的微小变化都能被它吸进去，所以对污染特别敏感。如果一个池塘里青蛙又多又活泼，通常说明那里的水干净、生态很好。
Frogs have thin skin that soaks up even tiny changes in water, so they are very sensitive to pollution. When a pond has many lively frogs, it usually means the water is clean and the ecosystem is healthy.

为什么小蚯蚓是泥土里的好帮手？

Why are earthworms good helpers in the soil?

蚯蚓在泥土里钻来钻去，会把枯叶变成肥沃的养分，让植物长得更好。它们松过的土软软的，小草和小花都很喜欢。
Earthworms wiggle through the soil and turn dead leaves into rich food for plants, helping them grow strong. The soil they loosen is soft and cozy for grass and flowers.

为什么刺猬喜欢住在树篱里？

Why do hedgehogs like living in hedges?

树篱里有很多落叶和虫子，刺猬可以在里面找吃的，还能卷成小球躲起来睡觉。如果我们留一处乱糟糟的小角落，刺猬就会有安全的家。
Hedgerows are full of leaves and bugs, so hedgehogs can find food there and curl into a ball to sleep safely. If we leave one messy little corner, hedgehogs get a safe home.

为什么蜘蛛其实是我们的好朋友？

Why are spiders actually our friends?

蜘蛛会织网抓住蚊子和小飞虫，帮我们减少讨厌的虫子。花园里有一只蜘蛛，就等于多了一位不用付钱的小帮手。
Spiders spin webs that catch mosquitoes and little flies, helping us have fewer pesky bugs. A spider in the garden is like a tiny helper who works for free.

为什么大熊猫最爱吃竹子？

Why do giant pandas love bamboo so much?

大熊猫住在长满竹子的山上，竹子又多又方便吃，所以它们几乎天天吃竹子。一只大熊猫一天能吃掉十几公斤的竹子，吃饱了才有力气在林子里玩耍。
Giant pandas live on mountains covered with bamboo, so it is easy and plentiful to eat and they munch it almost every day. One panda can eat over ten kilograms of bamboo a day, which gives it energy to play.

为什么蚂蚁总是成群一起工作？

Why do ants always work together in groups?

蚂蚁虽然很小，但它们会分工合作：有的找食物，有的照顾宝宝，有的守家门。大家一起努力，就能把比自己大很多倍的食物搬回窝里。
Ants are tiny, but they divide the work: some search for food, some care for babies, and some guard the nest. By working together, they can carry food many times their own size back home.

为什么帝王蝶要飞过整个国家去南方？

Why do monarch butterflies fly across a whole country to the south?

每到秋天，成千上万只帝王蝶会从加拿大和美国北部飞到墨西哥温暖的森林里过冬，路程长达几千公里。它们靠体内的罗盘感受阳光方向，一代代接力完成这趟奇妙的旅行。
Every autumn, millions of monarch butterflies fly from Canada and the northern U.S. to warm forests in Mexico for winter, a journey of thousands of kilometers. Guided by an inner compass that senses the sun, they complete this amazing trip across generations.

为什么蜜蜂要酿造甜甜的蜂蜜？

Why do bees make sweet honey?

蜜蜂把花里的花蜜带回蜂巢，慢慢酿成蜂蜜，作为冬天吃的食物。甜甜的蜂蜜，是小蜜蜂辛苦劳动的结果。
Bees carry nectar from flowers back to the hive and slowly turn it into honey to eat during winter. Sweet honey is the hard work of little bees.

为什么海龟要回到出生的海滩下蛋？

Why do sea turtles return to the beach where they were born to lay eggs?

小海龟在沙子里孵化后游向大海，长大后却能凭着对地球磁场的记忆，游回自己出生的那片海滩产卵。保护这些安静的海滩，就能让海龟宝宝安全来到世界上。
Baby sea turtles hatch in the sand and swim to the sea, but as adults they use memory of Earth's magnetic field to return to the very beach where they were born to lay eggs. Protecting these quiet beaches helps turtle babies arrive safely in the world.

为什么小蜜蜂对我们很重要？

Why are little bees so important to us?

蜜蜂在花间飞来飞去时，会把花粉带到别的花上，帮助植物结出果实。没有蜜蜂，许多好吃的水果就长不出来啦。
As bees flutter between flowers, they carry pollen to other blooms and help plants grow fruit. Without bees, many yummy fruits would not grow.

为什么蝙蝠在夜里帮了我们大忙？

Why do bats help us a lot at night?

蝙蝠晚上飞出来，用耳朵听着抓住许多蚊子和害虫。一只小蝙蝠一晚上能吃掉好几百只虫子，是我们安静的小卫士。
Bats fly out at night and use their ears to hear and catch many mosquitoes and pests. One little bat can eat hundreds of bugs in a single night, a quiet guardian for us.

为什么湿地对大自然有帮助？

Why do wetlands help nature?

湿地像大地的一块大海绵，能慢慢吸住雨水，还能让植物把水里的脏东西过滤干净。许多小鸟和青蛙都喜欢在湿地里找吃的、生宝宝。
Wetlands are like a big sponge for the land, slowly soaking up rainwater and letting plants filter dirt out of the water. Many birds and frogs love to find food and raise babies in wetlands.

为什么大象需要很大的地方生活？

Why do elephants need so much space to live?

大象是很大的动物，每天要吃很多草和树叶，所以需要广阔的草地和森林走来走去。当森林被分割成小块时，象群就很难找到足够的食物和水。
Elephants are huge animals that eat lots of grass and leaves every day, so they need wide-open land and forests to roam. When forests are split into small pieces, elephant families find it hard to get enough food and water.

为什么森林是小动物们的家？

Why are forests home to so many little animals?

森林里有高高的树木、灌木和落叶，给小鸟、松鼠和昆虫提供了吃饭、躲藏和养育宝宝的地方。一棵老树就像一个小小的公寓，住着许多不同的动物。
Forests have tall trees, bushes, and fallen leaves that give birds, squirrels, and insects places to eat, hide, and raise their babies. One old tree is like a small apartment where many different animals live.

为什么瓢虫是花园里的小卫士？

Why are ladybugs little guardians of the garden?

瓢虫最爱吃蚜虫，而蚜虫会咬坏蔬菜和小花。一只瓢虫一天能吃掉几十只蚜虫，帮我们的菜园保持健康，不用喷药水。
Ladybugs love to eat aphids, the tiny bugs that nibble on vegetables and flowers. One ladybug can eat dozens of aphids in a day, keeping our garden healthy without sprays.

为什么章鱼能变成石头或沙子的颜色？

Why can an octopus turn the color of rock or sand?

章鱼皮肤里藏着许多会变色的小袋子，紧张或想躲起来时，就能瞬间变成周围的颜色。这样它既能悄悄躲开敌人，也能悄悄靠近小虾当晚餐。
An octopus has tiny color-changing pockets in its skin, so it can instantly match the color around it when scared or hiding. This lets it sneak away from enemies and also sneak up on shrimp for dinner.

为什么鲸鱼对整片海洋都很重要？

Why are whales important to the whole ocean?

鲸鱼在深海和海面之间上下游动，把营养从海底带到阳光能照到的地方，喂饱小小的浮游生物。它们死后沉入海底，还会变成许多深海动物的食物，让生命一直循环下去。
Whales swim up and down between the deep sea and the surface, carrying nutrients from the bottom to where sunlight reaches, feeding tiny plankton. When they die and sink, they become food for deep-sea animals, keeping life cycling onward.

为什么珊瑚礁对海洋很重要？

Why are coral reefs important to the ocean?

珊瑚礁只占海底很小一部分，却住着大约四分之一的海洋鱼类，是海洋里最热闹的城市。它们还像防波堤一样减弱海浪，保护海岸边的沙滩和村庄。
Coral reefs cover only a tiny part of the seafloor yet shelter about one quarter of all ocean fish, making them the busiest cities of the sea. They also work like breakwaters, softening waves and protecting beaches and villages along the coast.

为什么有些小鸟要飞到很远的地方过冬？

Why do some birds fly far away to spend the winter?

当北方天气变冷、虫子和果子变少时，许多鸟会顺着固定路线飞到温暖的地方找食物。它们靠太阳、星星和地磁场认路，每年都能飞回同一个小池塘。
When the north grows cold and insects and berries grow scarce, many birds follow set routes to warmer places with food. They navigate by the sun, the stars, and Earth's magnetic field, and return to the same little pond each year.

为什么小松鼠要把坚果藏起来？

Why do squirrels hide their nuts?

秋天果子很多，松鼠会把坚果埋进土里留着冬天吃。有时它们忘记了，埋下的种子就会长出新的小树苗。
In autumn there is lots of food, so squirrels bury nuts in the soil to save for winter. Sometimes they forget, and the buried seeds grow into new little trees.
